verdict.rationale: The agents tools documentation lists "MCP server" as a tool type, described as "an external server, for systems that aren't pieces." This shows agents can be connected to external MCP servers and call their tools. It is only a one-line mention, and the built-in MCP server evidence (Activepieces acting as a server) is not credited here. Missing for 10: setup and configuration details (transport, auth, how servers are added), whether this works in flows as well as agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
